data.name: SettingsRecognizeUnfound
data.value: Recognize songs whose lyrics are not found (Shazam)

data.name: RecognizeUnfoundHint
data.value: Only when no source has the lyrics, the app listens to the player for a few seconds (up to 12) and sends a fingerprint of the sound to Shazam to learn the real song name. The sound itself is not recorded or sent. This happens once per song; the lyrics found are saved under the name the player shows.

data.name: SettingsLyricsOnly
data.value: Lyrics only: transparent window, clicks that miss the letters go through. Click a line to show the controls, double-click to leave the mode.

data.name: ToolStreamerMode
data.value: Streamer mode (plain window for OBS and other capture programs)

data.name: SettingsStreamerMode
data.value: Streamer mode: only the song name, the artist and the lyrics on a transparent window; every click goes through to what is behind it

data.name: StreamerModeHint
data.value: Made for window capture. Move the mouse over the window to get two small buttons in one corner: move and leave the mode. In OBS add a Window Capture source; for a transparent background choose the capture method "Windows 10 (1903 and up)". With the BitBlt method the background comes out black.

data.name: SettingsStreamerProgress
data.value: Show the elapsed time, the song's length and a progress bar on the song card

data.name: SettingsFocusMode
data.value: Karaoke focus: only the active line and nearby lines

data.name: SettingsLineFill
data.value: Line fill effect (the active line fills from left to right as it is sung; uses a little more CPU while playing)

data.name: VersionNoticeText
data.value: This version is not the same length as the recording the lyrics were timed for, so the lines may come early or late. The − and + buttons above shift them.

data.name: SourcesHint
data.value: The lyrics follow the player that is playing a song. While a song plays, something started in another app does not take the window over. Long recordings without an album (talks, podcasts, films) are not treated as songs and are not listened to for recognition. Untick an app to never follow it.

data.name: SourcesNone

data.name: SettingsVersionNotice
